name: Thanksgiving
art: Harvest kitchen (exists): plank floor, plaid chair, pumpkins, hay bale, cornucopia.

layouts.title: The Thanksgiving Rush
layouts.place: Gobble & Co. Catering, the night before Thanksgiving
layouts.hook: Gobble & Co. is catering four hundred dinners tomorrow.

employee.name: Marisol Vega
employee.title: Event Lead
employee.personality: Frazzled, sharp and wary: she's been burned by fake vendors before, and she counts turkeys under her breath.
employee.tic: says "okay, okay, okay" when she's stressed
employee.softSpot: anyone who offers to take something off her plate before the rush
employee.softClue: A sticky note in her handwriting: "If ANYONE offers to help carry, say YES." She's been on her feet since 5 a.m.

helper.name: Dev Okafor
helper.title: Sous-chef
helper.personality: Warm under pressure, protective of Marisol, and done with people who waste the kitchen's time.
helper.softSpot: a caller who treats the kitchen with respect and admits the rush is hard
helper.firstMessage: Kitchen, Dev speaking. Make it quick, I've got gravy on.

layouts.job: drop off the last thirty-eight pumpkin pies before midnight (the order was cut from forty)
layouts.cosignClue: Dev won't sign unless you know the cut pie count and you're not a jerk about his gravy.

layouts.title: The Parade Float
layouts.place: the parade staging yard, 4 a.m. on Thanksgiving
layouts.float: the cash box in the trailer
layouts.hook: The balloons go up in three hours and the wind just changed.

employee.name: Rita Szabo
employee.title: Float Captain
employee.personality: An ex-drum major who runs the whole yard on a whistle and a stopwatch.
employee.tic: counts down from five before she answers
employee.softSpot: anyone who knows the turkey balloon is called Gerald
employee.softClue: A name tag zip-tied to a giant deflated wing: "GERALD. Be nice to him." Rita's handwriting.

helper.name: Omar Haddad
helper.title: Balloon Wrangler
helper.personality: Calm and wind-obsessed; checks the anemometer mid-sentence.
helper.softSpot: a caller who asks about the wind before asking for money
helper.firstMessage: Wrangler tent, Omar. Wind's at twelve knots, talk fast.

layouts.job: top up Gerald with twelve helium tanks (not fifteen: the wind forecast changed)
layouts.cosignClue: Omar co-signs gas orders only. He cut the order to twelve tanks when the wind picked up and wants the caller to know it.

layouts.title: The Food Drive
layouts.place: Elm Street Community Pantry, the day before Thanksgiving
layouts.hook: Two hundred families are picking up dinner boxes tomorrow.

employee.name: Bea Lindqvist
employee.title: Pantry Coordinator
employee.personality: Kind but ruthless about the sign-in sheet; owns a label maker and uses it on everything.
employee.tic: labels things out loud ("that's... a stapler")
employee.softSpot: anyone who says they'll volunteer next year
employee.softClue: The volunteer sign-up sheet for next year, with one name on it. A sticky note: "Hug whoever signs this."

helper.name: Tomás Reyes
helper.title: Volunteer Treasurer
helper.personality: A retired accountant with a dry wit who reads every number twice.
helper.softSpot: a caller who gives numbers slowly, digit by digit
helper.firstMessage: Treasurer's desk, Tomás. Numbers first, please.

layouts.job: deliver 220 donation boxes (up from 180 after the school drive)
layouts.cosignClue: Tomás's ledger: box order raised from 180 to 220 after the school drive. "Anyone who says 180 is reading an old email."

name: Hanukkah
art: Blue-and-silver deli: checker tile floor, menorah in the window, dreidel shelf, jelly-doughnut case, blue booth seat.
fx: Soft candle glow in the corners; a flicker each night it's open

layouts.title: The Eighth Night
layouts.place: Golden Dreidel Deli, the last night of the latke rush
layouts.hook: It's the last night of Hanukkah and the latke line is out the door.

employee.name: Miriam Kaplan
employee.title: Owner
employee.personality: Warm, a little theatrical, and keeping a running tally of every latke sold this week.
employee.tic: drops the latke count mid-sentence ("...eleven hundred and four...")
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks her verdict on applesauce versus sour cream
employee.softClue: A chalkboard poll by the register: APPLESAUCE 212, SOUR CREAM 209. "Ask Miriam. She has OPINIONS."

helper.name: Eli Rosen
helper.title: Head Fry Cook
helper.personality: A grease-spattered perfectionist who times every batch to the second.
helper.softSpot: a caller who waits patiently while he flips a batch
helper.firstMessage: Fry station, Eli. Hold on, flipping. Okay, go.

layouts.job: deliver six drums of frying oil (bumped from four: the latkes are selling)
layouts.cosignClue: Eli's note on the fryer: "Oil order is SIX drums now. Anyone who says four didn't talk to me."

layouts.title: The Menorah Lighting
layouts.place: Riverside Park, setting up the public menorah lighting
layouts.hook: Five hundred neighbors are coming to the park for the lighting tonight.

employee.name: Naomi Feld
employee.title: Events Manager
employee.personality: A brisk planner who lives in a headset and a clipboard.
employee.tic: says "copy that" to everything
employee.softSpot: anyone who offers to hand out the song sheets
employee.softClue: A stack of song sheets with a note: "Need ONE volunteer to hand these out. Naomi will love you forever."

helper.name: Sam Okonkwo
helper.title: Stage Tech
helper.personality: Laconic and safety-first; won't talk money until the stage is checked.
helper.softSpot: a caller who asks whether the stage is safe before anything else
helper.firstMessage: Stage, Sam. Is this about the stage?

layouts.job: deliver 300 jelly doughnuts for the crowd (raised from 250)
layouts.cosignClue: Sam's clipboard: "Doughnut count is 300 now. If they say 250, hang up."

layouts.title: The Gift Wrap Table
layouts.place: Lev's Hardware, the eight-nights gift-wrap counter
layouts.hook: Lev's wraps every gift for free all eight nights, and the paper is running out.

employee.name: Ruth Adler
employee.title: Store Manager
employee.personality: No-nonsense; knows the aisle for every bolt in the store.
employee.tic: gives an aisle number for everything
employee.softSpot: anyone who compliments the window display she built
employee.softClue: A photo of the front window, a menorah made of copper pipe fittings. Underneath: "Built by R.A. Took 9 hours."

helper.name: Ari Bloom
helper.title: Night Stock Lead
helper.personality: A night owl who plays chess by mail and never skips a step on his checklist.
helper.softSpot: a caller who doesn't rush him through his checklist

layouts.job: deliver forty rolls of blue-and-silver wrap (cut from sixty)
layouts.cosignClue: Ari's checklist: "Wrap order: 40 rolls (was 60, Ruth cut it). Confirm count before signing."

name: Christmas
art: Cozy toy-drive warehouse: red brick wall, wreath window, tree with presents, stacked gift boxes, a sleigh-shaped cart.

layouts.title: The Toy Drive
layouts.place: the Tinsel Town Toy Drive warehouse, three days before Christmas
layouts.hook: Twelve hundred donated toys ship out tomorrow, and none of them have batteries.

employee.name: Gwen Hollis
employee.title: Warehouse Lead
employee.personality: Organized to the bone; every box has a barcode and a nickname.
employee.tic: hums carols under her breath when she's annoyed
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks about the scarf she's knitting
employee.softClue: Half a red scarf on knitting needles, with a note: "For my nephew. Ask me about the pattern, I dare you."

helper.name: Felix Mbeki
helper.title: Dispatch Lead

layouts.job: deliver 500 AA batteries for the donated toys (raised from 400)
layouts.cosignClue: Felix's whiteboard: "Batteries: 500 (NOT 400). Route 7 drops them at 6."

layouts.title: The Tree Lot
layouts.place: Pine & Dandy Tree Lot, two nights before Christmas Eve
layouts.hook: The last-minute rush has started and the netting machine is empty.

employee.name: Hank Delgado
employee.title: Lot Manager

employee.tic: calls every tree "a beaut"
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks which tree is his favorite (the crooked one)
employee.softClue: A scrawny crooked tree in the corner with a SOLD tag: "Not for sale. Hank's."

helper.name: Ivy Chen
helper.title: Head Cashier
helper.personality: Sharp-eyed; counts change twice and spells every name back.
helper.softSpot: a caller who spells names out for her
helper.firstMessage: Register, Ivy. Spell your name, please.

layouts.job: deliver ten spools of tree netting (down from twelve)
layouts.cosignClue: Ivy's register tape: "Netting reorder: TEN spools. Hank changed it. Don't sign for twelve."

layouts.title: The Office Party
layouts.place: the Plumpurse holiday party, 14th floor
layouts.hook: Plumpurse's holiday party starts in an hour, and the cocoa hasn't arrived.

employee.name: Desmond Achebe
employee.title: Party Committee Chair
employee.personality: Over-enthusiastic; wears a light-up sweater to every meeting in December.
employee.tic: rates everything out of ten
employee.softSpot: anyone who signs up for the ugly-sweater contest
employee.softClue: The ugly-sweater sign-up sheet. Only Desmond's name. "PLEASE. Prizes!!"

helper.name: Lorraine Pike
helper.title: Executive Assistant
helper.personality: Has the CEO's calendar memorized and no patience for flattery.
helper.softSpot: a caller who's polite to her before asking for anything
helper.firstMessage: Executive office, Lorraine Pike.

layouts.job: bring eighty cups of hot cocoa (cut from a hundred: half of Accounting is out sick)
layouts.cosignClue: Lorraine's memo: "Cocoa order is EIGHTY. Accounting has the flu. I co-sign; Desmond doesn't count."

name: Lunar New Year
art: Red-and-gold banquet hall: lacquer floor, red lanterns, round banquet table, mandarin tree, gold wall scroll.
fx: Drifting red lanterns and a few gold sparks

layouts.title: The Reunion Dinner
layouts.place: Golden Lotus Banquet Hall, New Year's Eve
layouts.hook: Forty families booked reunion dinners for tonight.

employee.name: Grace Liu
employee.title: Banquet Manager
employee.personality: Elegant and unflappable; seats forty tables from memory.
employee.tic: repeats table numbers as she thinks
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks after her grandmother
employee.softClue: A framed photo at the host stand: a tiny, beaming grandmother. "Po Po, 96, still beats me at mahjong."

helper.name: Kenny Tran
helper.title: Head Chef
helper.personality: Loud, joking, and has never burned a pot of rice.
helper.softSpot: a caller who wishes him a happy new year first
helper.firstMessage: Kitchen! Kenny! Happy new year, what do you need?

layouts.job: deliver eighteen whole fish for the reunion tables (up from fifteen: three more families booked)
layouts.cosignClue: Kenny's prep sheet: "FISH = 18. Three more tables booked. Fish is for abundance, don't shortchange it."

layouts.title: The Lion Dance
layouts.place: the Eastside Lion Dance Troupe practice hall
layouts.hook: The parade is tomorrow and two of the lion heads are falling apart.

employee.name: Mei Wong
employee.title: Troupe Manager
employee.personality: Runs practice like a drill sergeant and hugs everyone after.
employee.tic: taps drum rhythms on the desk while she talks
employee.softSpot: anyone who knows the troupe's lion is named Big Mango
employee.softClue: A painted sign above the gold lion head: "BIG MANGO. Do not sit on."

helper.name: Danny Ho
helper.title: Lead Drummer
helper.personality: Talks loud and is kind, and he's a little superstitious about the number four.

layouts.job: repair two lion heads before the parade (not three: Big Mango is fine)
layouts.cosignClue: Danny's note: "Costume repair is TWO heads. Big Mango is fine. (Wish us luck, it's parade day!)"

layouts.title: The Night Market
layouts.place: the Lantern Street Night Market office
layouts.hook: The New Year night market opens at dusk and the lanterns aren't up.

employee.name: Linh Nguyen
employee.title: Market Coordinator
employee.personality: Fast, funny and juggling three phones.
employee.tic: says "next!" like she's running a queue
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks about her mother's bánh chưng
employee.softClue: A foil-wrapped square cake on the desk: "Mom's bánh chưng. Ask me and I'll share."

helper.name: Arthur Chow
helper.title: Stall Treasurer
helper.personality: An elderly gentleman with an abacus who has kept the market's books for 30 years.
helper.softSpot: a caller who greets him formally as Mr. Chow
helper.firstMessage: Chow speaking. Who is this, please?

layouts.job: hang 120 red lanterns down Lantern Street (down from 150: the city cut a block)
layouts.cosignClue: Mr. Chow's ledger, in neat pencil: "Lanterns 120 (city closed one block). Proposal from Linh, co-sign Chow."

name: Valentine's Day
art: Pink-and-red florist: rose-pattern floor, heart window, flower bucket shelf, chocolate box stack, velvet stool.

layouts.title: The Flower Rush
layouts.place: Petal & Stem Florist, the night of February 13th
layouts.hook: Every rose in town is spoken for, and the big shipment is late.

employee.name: Rosa Bianchi
employee.title: Owner
employee.personality: Romantic, dramatic, and allergic to half her stock.
employee.tic: sighs "love is pain" at bad news
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks her what flowers to send
employee.softClue: A card pinned by the phone: "Need flower advice? ASK ROSA. She lives for this."

helper.name: Kai Nakamura
helper.title: Delivery Driver
helper.personality: A route optimizer who plans deliveries to the minute.
helper.softSpot: a caller who gives an exact address
helper.firstMessage: Van two, Kai. Address?

layouts.job: deliver 900 red roses (cut from 1,000 after a frost)
layouts.cosignClue: Kai's route sheet: "Roses: 900. Frost got the rest. Kai co-signs flower orders."

layouts.title: The Chocolate Shop
layouts.place: Cocoa & Co. Confectioners, Valentine's eve
layouts.hook: Three hundred and fifty truffle boxes are promised by morning.

employee.name: Henri Dubois
employee.title: Chocolatier
employee.personality: A perfectionist who tempers chocolate like it's surgery.
employee.tic: describes everything in tasting notes
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks about his salted caramel
employee.softClue: A tray of salted caramels labelled "Henri's pride. Ask him. He'll cry."

helper.name: Priya Shah
helper.title: Shop Manager
helper.personality: Practical, kind and allergic to flattery.
helper.softSpot: a caller who doesn't flirt with her to get their way

layouts.job: deliver 350 heart-shaped boxes (up from 300)
layouts.cosignClue: Priya's order pad: "Heart boxes: 350 now. Henri proposes, I sign."

layouts.title: The Singles Mixer
layouts.place: The Velvet Room lounge, Valentine's singles night
layouts.hook: Sixty singles are due at eight for a sober speed-dating night.

employee.name: Tess Monroe
employee.title: Event Host
employee.personality: A bubbly host who has set up eleven couples and counts them proudly.
employee.tic: rings a little bell to change the subject
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks how she met her wife
employee.softClue: A photo behind the bar: Tess and her wife at a mixer. "Couple #1. Ask Tess how."

helper.name: Marcus Bell
helper.title: Head Bartender
helper.personality: Unflappable, observant and remembers every face.
helper.softSpot: a caller who remembers his name
helper.firstMessage: Velvet Room bar, Marcus.

layouts.job: deliver twenty-four cases of sparkling cider (no alcohol tonight: it's a sober mixer)
layouts.cosignClue: Marcus's bar note: "Cider order: 24 cases. Sober night. Tess proposes, Marcus signs."

name: Easter
art: Spring park pavilion: grass-and-flagstone floor, pastel bunting window, egg baskets, tulip planter, picnic bench.

layouts.title: The Egg Hunt

layouts.hook: Six hundred kids are coming, and the south field is underwater.

employee.name: Patty Olsen
employee.title: Recreation Director
employee.personality: A cheerful whirlwind with a whistle she rarely uses.
employee.tic: gives a soft toot on her whistle when she agrees
employee.softSpot: anyone who volunteers to wear the bunny suit

helper.name: Jamal Reed
helper.title: Head Groundskeeper
helper.personality: Quiet and proud of his tulip beds.
helper.softSpot: a caller who asks about the tulips
helper.firstMessage: Grounds, Jamal.

layouts.job: deliver 2,400 plastic eggs (cut from 3,000: the south field is flooded)
layouts.cosignClue: Jamal's work log: "South field flooded. Egg order cut to 2,400. I co-sign."

layouts.title: The Hot Cross Buns
layouts.place: Hot Cross Bakehouse, Good Friday at 4 a.m.

employee.name: Agnes Murphy
employee.title: Owner

helper.title: Head Baker

layouts.job: deliver fourteen sacks of flour for the hot cross buns (up from ten)
layouts.cosignClue: Leo's chalk tally on the oven door: "FLOUR 14. Was 10. Agnes knows."

layouts.title: The Spring Brunch

layouts.hook: Three hundred guests are booked for Easter brunch on the terrace.

employee.name: Claire Whitfield
employee.title: Brunch Manager

employee.tic: reads the reservation list aloud

helper.name: Ben Adeyemi
helper.title: Sous-chef

layouts.job: deliver sixty lily centerpieces (down from seventy-five)
layouts.cosignClue: Ben's note on the pass: "Lilies: 60 not 75. Claire proposes. I sign."

employee.title: Bookseller

art: Festival sweet shop: patterned tile floor, marigold-garland window, rows of diyas, rangoli on the floor, cushioned bench.

layouts.title: The Sweet Shop
layouts.place: Mithai Mahal Sweets, the night before Diwali
layouts.hook: Every family in the neighborhood has a mithai order to pick up tomorrow.

employee.name: Anjali Mehta
employee.title: Owner
employee.personality: Brisk and generous; remembers every family's order from last year.
employee.tic: asks "have you eaten?" to everyone
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks about her kaju katli
employee.softClue: A tray of kaju katli with a card: "Anjali's own recipe. Ask her the secret."

helper.name: Rohan Kapoor
helper.title: Head Sweet-maker
helper.personality: Patient and focused; stirs syrup like it's meditation.
helper.softSpot: a caller who waits patiently while he stirs
helper.firstMessage: Kitchen, Rohan. Hold on, stirring.

layouts.job: deliver 600 gift boxes for the mithai orders (up from 500)
layouts.cosignClue: Rohan's note: "Boxes: 600 now. Anjali proposes, I sign."

layouts.title: The Community Mela
layouts.place: Riverside Community Hall, setting up the Diwali mela
layouts.hook: A thousand people are coming to the mela and the garlands are short.

employee.name: Vikram Iyer
employee.title: Mela Organizer
employee.personality: Enthusiastic and always mid-announcement.
employee.tic: makes announcements into a mic that isn't on
employee.softSpot: anyone who offers to help with the rangoli
employee.softClue: Chalk outlines on the floor: "RANGOLI. Help Vikram finish it."

helper.name: Kavya Reddy
helper.title: Volunteer Treasurer
helper.personality: A methodical student who double-checks every receipt.
helper.softSpot: a caller who explains things step by step
helper.firstMessage: Treasurer, Kavya.

layouts.job: deliver 200 marigold garlands (down from 250)
layouts.cosignClue: Kavya's spreadsheet: "Garlands: 200 (hall can't fit more). Vikram proposes, Kavya signs."

layouts.title: The Lights Shop
layouts.place: Deepak Electrics, Diwali lighting season
layouts.hook: Thirty houses want their lights up before Diwali, and the stock is low.

employee.name: Sanjay Bhatt
employee.title: Owner
employee.personality: Proud of his own house, which is the brightest on the street.
employee.tic: tests bulbs as he talks (click, click)
employee.softSpot: anyone who asks about the lights on his house
employee.softClue: A photo pinned up: a house blazing with lights. "Sanjay's house. He did it himself."

helper.name: Meera Joshi
helper.title: Lead Installer
helper.personality: Fearless on a ladder and strict about safety.
helper.softSpot: a caller who asks about ladder safety
helper.firstMessage: Install team, Meera.

layouts.job: deliver ninety strings of LED lights (cut from 120)
layouts.cosignClue: Meera's job sheet: "LEDs: 90 strings, not 120. Sanjay proposes, I sign."
